title: ornithogalum orthophyllum subsp. baeticum
intro: Ornithogalum orthophyllum subsp. baeticum, commonly known as the Baetic Ornithogalum, is a plant species that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. The Baetic Ornithogalum is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the Baetic Ornithogalum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
